# hermes-lcm-ledger v1.1.0

When two Hermes instances receive overlapping history for the same session, Ledger now serializes reconciliation and append. Distinct occurrences in the delivered history retain distinct message IDs. The fix also applies to existing `lcm.db` archives.

The optional compact format stores matching tool responses of at least 256 bytes once. Message-level timestamps, session membership, searches and citation offsets remain available. Upgrading the plugin leaves conversion under operator control. The converter creates and verifies a separate database. [Conversion and rollback guide](https://github.com/ben-wf/hermes-lcm-ledger/blob/v1.1.0/docs/operator-guide.md#compact-a-ledger-archive)

Benjamin Wittorf maintains this fork of Hermes-LCM by Stephen Schoettler and contributors. [Original fork changes in PR #589](https://github.com/stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm/pull/589)
